notes: Checked robots.txt first (no Claude-specific disallow; sitemap index lists sitemaps/collections.xml.gz among others). Tier 1 (HTTP): fetched homepage HTML (SSR React Router/Remix app) and the full collections sitemap (sitemaps/collections.xml.gz, gunzipped to 2551 <loc> entries / 913 unique category URLs after stripping pagination). Keyword-scanned every collection URL for christmas/xmas/cny/chinese-new-year/lunar-new-year/hari-raya/eid/diwali/deepavali/valentine/easter/thanksgiving/halloween/festive/festival/seasonal/holiday - zero genuine matches (only false positive 'heidi-by-hipvan', a furniture line name containing 'eid' as a substring). Also manually eyeballed the full 913-URL list (by-hipvan house brands, room categories, furniture/kitchen/decor/lighting/rugs/electronics subcategories, sale/clearance pages) - no holiday-named category exists anywhere in the taxonomy. Category PLP pages (e.g. /decor/wall-mirrors) render product grids client-side via JS fetch to api.communa.sg, so product counts aren't visible in raw HTTP HTML - escalated to tier 2 (Claude-in-Chrome/CDP rendering, used as the practical substitute for Playwright since that's the browser automation available) to verify the real rendered nav and search behavior. Rendered homepage top nav bar (read via accessibility tree): Sofas, Dining, Beds, Mattresses, Furniture, Kids, Lightings, Decor, Rugs, Soft Furnishings, Kitchen, Electronics, Sale, New Arrivals, Gift Cards - no seasonal/holiday entry. The /decor category's 46 sub-collections (from sitemap: clocks, mirrors, plants, wall art, cushions/throws, vases, garden decor, storage, wall decals, etc.) contain no holiday-specific subcategory. Tested the site's own internal search (rendered, not just HTTP) for every target holiday relevant to a Singapore multicultural market: 'christmas' returned only 9 loosely-matched generic products (fairy lights, cushion covers, one Christmas-themed coaster set) via fuzzy text search, not a real curated PLP/category - excluded per the marketing/search-noise rule; 'chinese new year' = 0 items; 'cny' = 273 items but this is pure substring/fuzzy-match noise (random sofas, mattresses, frames - nothing CNY-specific), not evidence of a real category; 'hari raya' = 0 items; 'deepavali' = 0 items; 'halloween' = 0 items. Also opened /gifting-guide (a real 56-item PLP) but it is a generic year-round 'Gifting Guide' category not tied to any specific holiday by the site itself, so it does not qualify as a seasonal/holiday row per the boundary rule that a category merely containing gift-type products isn't itself a seasonal category. A 'mothers-day-gift-ideas' collection also exists in the sitemap but Mother's Day is outside this project's target holiday set (not Christmas/Halloween/Diwali/Easter/Valentine/Thanksgiving/CNY/Hari-Raya) and was not pursued further. Conclusion: HipVan Singapore's own site taxonomy presents no genuine Christmas, Chinese New Year/CNY, Hari Raya/Eid, Diwali/Deepavali, Halloween, Valentine's Day, Easter, or Thanksgiving category - status set to no_seasonal with an empty rows array.
